title: Add neon glow effect and custom font styling to nav branding and accent elements

requirements.summary: Enhance the 'NFS MODS HUB' navigation branding with neon glow effect and Barlow Condensed bold typeface
acceptanceCriteria: The 'NFS MODS HUB' nav text displays a visible neon glow effect using #C8FF00 or equivalent CSS variable
The Barlow Condensed bold typeface is applied to the nav branding text
The glow effect is consistent with the dark racing theme and does not interfere with readability

file_operations.description: Add neon glow styling classes to the 'NFS MODS HUB' text element. Apply Barlow Condensed bold font family and neon glow utility classes (to be defined in REQ-18) that use text-shadow with the #C8FF00 accent color. Optionally add a subtle pulsing animation class for visual impact.

requirements.summary: Apply reusable neon glow styling to key accent elements across the site including buttons, nav links, category badges, and card hover borders
acceptanceCriteria: Neon glow effects are applied to primary CTA buttons (Upload Mod, Download, Login)
Card hover borders emit a neon glow effect consistent with the accent color
Active or hovered nav links show a neon glow or underline accent
Glow utility classes are defined in a reusable way (Tailwind config or CSS variables)
The effects are consistent across all pages and do not cause layout shifts

file_operations.description: Extend the Tailwind configuration to add custom neon glow utilities. Define box-shadow variants for neon glow effects (neon-glow-sm, neon-glow, neon-glow-lg) using the #C8FF00 accent color. Add text-shadow utilities (text-neon-glow) for text elements. Optionally define a subtle pulsing animation keyframe for neon effects.

Add custom CSS classes for neon glow effects using the existing --color-accent CSS variable. Define reusable utility classes (.neon-text-glow, .neon-border-glow, .neon-button-glow) with text-shadow and box-shadow properties. Include optional pulsing animation keyframes and apply animation classes. Ensure effects use the #C8FF00 accent color and are consistent with the dark theme.

Apply neon glow utility classes to the Upload Mod button and navigation links. Add hover state classes that trigger neon glow effects on nav links (Browse Mods, My Mods). Ensure active/hovered links display a neon underline or glow accent consistent with the accent color.

Add neon glow effects to the card hover state borders and category badges. Apply the neon-border-glow utility class on hover to emit a glow effect using the #C8FF00 accent color. Ensure the hover animation does not cause layout shifts and maintains smooth transitions.
Apply neon glow utility classes to the primary Upload button in the form. Ensure the button displays a consistent neon glow effect on hover and focus states using the defined utility classes.
Apply neon glow utility classes to the Download button. Ensure the button displays a consistent neon glow effect on hover and active states using the #C8FF00 accent color and defined utility classes.
